_comment: Representative v3.0 build prompts for the cheap-model bake-off. Mix of simple → complex so a candidate model is tested across the range it would actually face. Edit freely; keep them buildable web apps.

prompts.prompt: Build a todo app: add, complete and delete tasks, persisted in localStorage. Clean React + Tailwind UI.
Build a calculator app with a keypad, +-*/, clear, and a running result. React + Tailwind.
Build a notes app: create, edit, search and delete notes, saved in localStorage. Sidebar list + editor.
Build a weather dashboard UI: a search bar, a current-weather card, and a 5-day forecast row. Use mock data (no real API). Responsive React + Tailwind.
Build an expense tracker: add income/expense entries with category and amount, show a running balance and a category breakdown. localStorage. React + Tailwind.
Build a kanban board with three columns (To Do / Doing / Done), add cards, and move cards between columns with buttons. localStorage. React + Tailwind.

Build a contacts manager with a mock login screen (any email/password), then a protected page to list, add, edit and delete contacts (name, email, phone), persisted in localStorage. Use react-router-dom. React + Tailwind.

Build an admin dashboard: a sidebar nav, a top bar, KPI stat cards, a simple bar chart and a recent-activity table — all from mock data. Responsive. react-router-dom for two pages (Overview, Reports). React + Tailwind.
